TRUTH CHECK: HEK293T cells are derived from the kidney, making this a factually correct inference.
COMPLETENESS CHECK: The paper also mentions Caco-2 and RKO cells (colon/epithelial) and intestinal, oral, and vaginal epithelial cells, but the specific MS experiment described in the "Mass spectrometry" section refers to the identification of proteins interacting with stathmin-GFP (from HEK293T) and phosphorylation sites of stathmin-GFP (from HEK293T). The MS samples specifically came from the transfected HEK293T cells.
